content: अप {%ind.%} [न पाति रक्षति पतनात् पा-ड <ls>Tv.</ls>] .²1 (As a prefix to verbs it means) .³({%a%}) Away, away from, denoting वियोग; अपयाति, अपनयति; .³({%b%}) deterioration (विकृति); अपकरोति does wrongly or badly; .³({%c%}) opposition, negation, contradiction (विपरीत); अपकर्षति, अपचिनोति; .³({%d%}) direction or mention or illustration (निदर्शन); अपदिशति; .³({%e%}) exclusion (वर्जन); अपवह्, अपसृ {%<ab>Caus.</ab>%}; ({%f%}) joy, merriment or laughter (आनन्द); अपहसति; .³({%g%}) concealment or denial (चौर्य); अपलपति, अपवदते. .²2 As first member of <ab>Tat.</ab> or Bahuvrīhi <ab>comp.</ab> it has all the above senses; अपयानम्, अपकर्म, अपपाठः; अपशब्दः a bad or corrupt word; ˚भी fearless; ˚कल्मष stainless; अपरागः discontent (<ab>opp.</ab> to अनुराग); ˚मेघोदयं वर्षम् <ls>Ku. 6. 54</ls> <ab>&c.</ab> In most cases अप may be translated by ‘bad’, ‘inferior’, ‘corrupt’, ‘wrong’, ‘unworthy’ <ab>&c.</ab> It also means ‘going downwards’ as in अपानः. .²3 As a separable preposition (with a noun in the <ab>abl.</ab>) .³({%a%}) away from; यत्संप्रत्यप लोकेभ्यो लङ्कायां वसतिर्भयात् <ls>Rām.</ls>; .³({%b%}) without, on the outside of; अप हरेः संसारः <ls>Sk.</ls>; .³({%c%}) with the exception of, excepting; अप त्रिगर्तेभ्यो वृष्टो देवः <ls>Sk.</ls> on the outside of, with the exception of. In these senses अप may form adverbial compounds also (<ls>P. II. 1. 12</ls>); ˚विष्णु संसारः <ls>Sk.</ls> without Viṣṇu; ˚त्रिगर्तं वृष्टो देवः excepting त्रिगर्त <ab>&c.</ab> It also implies negation, contradiction <ab>&c.</ab>; ˚कामम्, ˚शङ्कम्. The senses of this word as given by <ls>G. M.</ls> may be thus put in verse; वर्जने विकृतौ चौर्ये विपरीतवियोगयोः . अपकृष्टे च निर्देशे हर्षे चापः प्रयुज्यते. [<ab>cf.</ab> <lang>L.</lang> {%ab%}; <lang>Gr.</lang> {%apo%}; <lang>Goth.</lang> {%af%}; <lang>Eng.</lang> {%of%} or {%off%}; <lang>Zend.</lang> {%apa%}].
